summary: Ultimate Railroads is a heavy worker-placement train-building game from the designers of Lorenzo il Magnifico-adjacent Euro pedigree, where players lay track, upgrade locomotives and technology, and build out a rail network across a shared map. It plays as a dense economic engine-builder in the vein of other Ohley/Orgler designs, with multiple paths to victory rather than a single dominant strategy.
praised: high production quality typical of the designers' recent titles
criticised: very heavy rules overhead and long playtime
can suffer from analysis paralysis with so many options
shared worker-placement spots can create early-game bottlenecks
not a lot of thematic train-building flavor beyond the track-laying visuals

interaction.detail: Players place workers on a shared row of action spaces to gain resources and tech, so taking a space or a market good first denies it to others that round, but each player then builds their own railway network on their own board. There is no way to damage or remove an opponent's track or workers directly.

scoring.how_you_win: You place workers to extend track, upgrade locomotives/technology, and produce goods; when the round track or supply runs out, points from network size, tech levels, and bonus cards are totaled and the highest sum wins.
